_comment: Copy this file to `release-local.json` beside it and fill it in.
`release-local.json` is gitignored and MUST STAY THAT WAY. It holds the live server
address and the FTP account name, which is why the build scripts read them from here
instead of hardcoding them: check-no-secrets.sh blocks a literal IP in any tracked
file, so a script with the address baked in can never be committed, which in turn
means the release tooling itself cannot live in the repo. This file is the seam that
lets the tooling be tracked and the address not be.
THERE IS NO PASSWORD IN HERE AND THERE MUST NEVER BE ONE.
The FTP password lives in Windows Credential Manager under `credential_target`.
cmdkey prompts for the password without echoing it and without putting it in your
shell history. scripts/deploy-ftp.py reads it back at runtime via the Windows
CredRead API. It is never printed, never logged and never passed on a command line.
